description: This PHP class defines a controller for managing custom fields within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for the PIM module. It contains constants for different screen contexts and field types, and provides methods to retrieve custom field services and prepare data for rendering in a Vue component.

classes.name: CustomFieldController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing custom fields in the PIM module of OrangeHRM, preparing data for Vue component rendering, and providing constants for UI options.

methods.name: getCustomFieldService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CustomFieldService used for managing custom fields.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with custom field data and configuration before rendering.
